text_block_list.text:
The fall Tenno Sho is here. The
atmosphere at the
racecourse is abuzz
with anticipation for Air
Groove and
Silenve Suzuka's rematch.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The two exchange a few quiet words. Air
Groove
has set her resolve, and Silence
Suzuka is excited
to race against this
renewed Эйр Грув.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
And so, the Empress—as the challenger
who
guides all Umamusume and as my
personal
ideal—steps up to take on the
fall Tenno Sho.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
